tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/
༄༅/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/

na ma stā rā yai/ rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza pa ra mārtha sarba karmo da ya nā ma tā rā yo gi nī tant+ra nā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas < la ma gyi phan yon mdor bstan pa ni/> dngos grub thams cad ni/ /rab tu sgrub byed bshad par bya/ /bud med <sa kyi dngos grub/ > bye ba phrag brgya yang*/ /bdag la dad pas 'dud par byed/ /lha dang lha min rig 'dzin dang*/ /mi yi gtso bo dbang du byed/ /nyi ma zla ba dang mtshungs shing*/ /mkha' lding rgyal pos rnam par 'dud/ /klu rnams sdigs par byed pa dang*/ /mi dang mi min gang gis <rdzogs rim gyi rgyu bde ba 'grub > yang*/ /bu mo thams cad 'dzag byed pa/ /skyes pa gcig gis 'dod chen gyis/ /mi yi bu mo khri phrag dang*/ /nyin rer lha dang lha min mo/ /bud med 'bum phrag zil gnon pa/ khu ba rengs pa'i byed pa las/ /gcig gis thams cad 'dod spyod pa/ /rdo rjer byed pa rab tu bshad/ /'jigs pa kun las thar pa dang*/ /bskal pa chen por tshe yang gnas/ /mkha' <'jig rten pa'i dngos grub gzhan bstan pa/> la 'gro dang mi snang dang*/ / ri lu la sogs rig 'dzin dang*/ /bcud kyis len dang gnod sbyin mo/ /rab tu sgrub byed sngags chen po/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po bye ba mthu chen dang*/ /grong khyer gsum 'joms tshangs sogs lha/ /mngag gzhug nyid du byed par 'gyur/ 'das <rgyud kyi byung tshul/> pa'i dus na rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor sprul/ /bde mchog bde mchog dgos rdo rje/ /yid bde thig le la sogs bstan/ /'bum phrag brgya pa sgrol ma yi/ / sngags kyi rgyal po sngon bshad pa/ /rdzogs ldan dus su mi rnams spyod/ /de nas 'bum phrag drug pa bshad/ /de yang nub nas khri nyis stong*/

/phyi ma'i dus su bshad pa yin/ /de yi snying po rtsod dus 'dir/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pas rnam spyod pas/ /nges brjod 'bum gyi rjes 'brang pa/ /slar yang rgyud 'di snang bar 'gyur/ /nges par <gsungs pa'i dgos pa/> 'dod chags chags chen 'dis/ /'dod ldan <longs sprul/>rnams la byang chub ster/ /sangs rgyas phrin las thams cad 'byung*/ /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya'i sngags/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'dus pa/ las/ /dam pa'i don yang 'grub pa'o/ /de nas bde chen/ bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol mas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ tā retuttā re tu re swā hā/ 'di ni/ <chos sku/> dngos grub thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswāhā/ ku ru kulle'o/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ oṃ tā re swāhā/ gsung bskul bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ/ thugs bskul bar byed pa'o/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo ārya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba duṣtaṃ/ pra duṣtaṃ ma ma kṛ te/ dzambha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo hā ya/ bandha ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣtaṃ staṃ bha ni tā re swāhā/ 'di ni las thams cad byed pa'o/ /laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ hūṃ/ lha mo lnga'i 'o/ /oṃ a ralli bhyo bhyo ha ha ha ha si si si si/ zhes pa ni he ru ka'i sngags so/ /oṃ a rall̥ ṛ gi pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ bhyo swāhā/ zhes pa ni sngags gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ badzra bā ra hī a be shā ya sarba dzwa ra ṇa hrīḥswāhā/ rdo rje phag mo'i 'o/ oṃ mā ri tsai maṃ swāhā/ 'od zer can ma'i 'o/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ral gcig ma'i 'o/ oṃ swāhā/ zhi bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ oṃ rgyas par byed pa'o/ /oṃ bī ṣa ṭa ho dbang du byed pa'o/ /oṃ phaṭa gsod par byed pa'o/ /swā hā laṃ laṃ laṃ hrīḥdzaḥphaṭa phaṭa/

ces pa ni las brgyad byed pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dgug par byed pa'o/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bsrung ba'i 'o/ /spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ spro ba'i 'o/ oṃ a kro dhai ka ya mānta ka hūṃ/ gshin rje gshed kyi'o/ /oṃ na mo a tsa la kā na tseṭṭa tseṭṭa moṭṭa moṭṭa tuṭṭa tuṭṭa gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gtum po'i 'o/ /oṃ padman ta kṛ ta badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hūṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta buddho bhyo na mo mahā badzra kro dhā ya/ mahā doṣtotki ṭi bhī ṣa ṇa bhai ra bā ya/ badzra sando ha darbā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i 'o/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de bī ka lī ka lī mahā ka lī hūṃ bhyo/ oṃ mahā ka lī de bī ka ra lī bi kranta kā la rā trī tsaṇḍa rū pi ṇī hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo nag mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ badzra ki li ki lā ya sarba bighnanbhandha hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bus gdab pa'i 'o/ /sngags kyi le'u ste dang po'o/ /de nas <lam gyi sngon 'gro phur gdab/ las ting nge 'dzin gyi phur gdab ni > bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas zhags pa dang lcags kyu'i tshogs spros te/ na maḥs manta kā ya wāktsitti badzra ṇaṃ/ oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags 'di phyung ngo*/ /gdug pa thams cad bkug nas kyang*/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgyel nas ni/ /rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros nas/ /gnas lnga dag tu phur bus btab/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khro bo che/ /rdo rje phur bu bskul bar mdzod/ /stong gsum dag gi khor yug la/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bcings par mdzad/ / oṃ laṃ stambha ya laṃ/ grong <dgra la phur gdab > mkhar sa la gzugs byas nas/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan byas la/ /mi rus las skyes phur bu yis/ /btab na de yi mod la 'chi/ /sbul <gnod byed gzhan la gdab pa > dang sedge glang po dang*/ rkun po'i yan lag dag la gdab/

/'di yis gdug cing sdang sems ldan/ /log 'dren dag la gdab par bya/ /ye shes padma kha phye nas/ /rdo rje phur bu'i rab sbyor bas/ /rang rang rigs kyi khro bor bcas/ /rdo rje sems sogs sngags la gdab/ /'di yis rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ rdo rje <rdo rje sems dpa' la phur gdab3gt; phur bus btab pa na/ phung po rab tu 'jig pa dang*/ rdo rje'i gnas kyang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig go /zla 'bras bu rnal 'byor chen po ba nyi ma'i rlung gi dbus/ /rang sngags sa bon bsgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid dmigs gyur na/ /bcu drug pa la de 'grub 'gyur/ /sems ni nam mkhar gyur pa la/ /zla ba nyi ma nub pa dang*/ /mun pa'i ye shes thim pa na/ /rdo rje'i lha ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /lus kyi dri ma rab sbyangs nas/ /ye shes chen po rang sngags lha/ /zla ba nya la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje gur sogs brtag par bya/ /'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba dang*/ /lus med rnams kyis kyang mi mthong*/ /spu las nad rnams spre'u 'am/ khyi dang 'dra bar rab tu dbyung*/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dam tshig 'dis/ /rdo rje mtshon chas bsnun par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /ye shes me dpung dkar po bsam/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /gnas las me ni 'bar bar bsgrub/ /mtshams med lnga dag byed pa yang*/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa rdo rje'i ye shes 'dis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /lte ba'i <rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po/> dbus su re kha bsam/ /a ni mchog tu phra ba ste/ /mi 'gyur nyams dga' bde ba'i gnas/ /mi shigs tshangs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags hūṃ dang yi ge oṃ/ /rdo rje āḥyig bsam par bya/ /rlung gi de nyid rab grub nas/

/mi 'gro drag po'i ngag tu 'gyur/ /'od zer rnam lnga snying gar gnas/ / padmas rdo rje rab dbye ba/ /thig le rdo rje byed pa ste/ /ye shes khyab 'jug rgyal por 'gyur/ <rgyas bshad ni/> de nas rdo rje snying po la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'di ci zhig lags/ lte ba las ni rlung khams 'byung*/ /ci phyir lus kyi chos su 'gyur/ /bdud las 'das pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ /ji ltar tshangs pa la sogs 'gyur/ /padmas rdo rje 'byed byed ci/ /'di dag ci phyir 'gal mi 'gyur/ /dam tshig de nyid mkhyen pas gsungs/ /nyon cig rdo rje ji bzhin nyon/ /lus ni gzhan dag yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam g.yo ba/ /de las 'khrul ba'i lus po byung*/ /lte ba sku zhes bshad pa de/ /de dag de las byung ba yin/ /bram ze mo la 'dod spyod pa/ /rdo rje sku ru 'gyur ba'o/ /rlung gis smra bar byed pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i ngag ste de nyid brjod/ /dbyangs mkhan bu mo'i dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje gsung du 'gyur ba yin/ /'khrul bas gnyis su rtog pa'i sems/ /thig le 'di las byung ba'i phyir/ /mig mdzes g.yung mo'i dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje thugs su 'gyur ba'o/ /nga ni 'gro bas mi shes te/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /'phrul ldan lha zhes 'jig rten rtog /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje ste/ / thams cad nga yi rnam par 'phrul/ /sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /'jug sel thugs kyi rdo rje'o/ /'di na yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can khams la dbyer med de/ /de dag rnams kyi lus ngag yid/ /mnyam 'gyur tshangs la sogs par snang*/ /lus ni sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /mgrin par de bzhin rmi lam mo/ /gnyid kyi rnal 'byor snying gar dgod/ /bde ba spyi bor mngon par brjod/ /gzhan yang rtsa lcug ljon pa

dang*/ /ri bong stag sogs chu bo dang*/ /nyin mtshan la sogs dngos kun tu/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan zlos gar mdzad/ /gnyid la rdo rjes rnam bsgom pa/ /tshangs pa'i dam tshig gti mug spong*/ /gzhan gyis gnyid dag spong bar dka'/ /bud med bral la sdom brtson med/ /'dod ldan tshangs spyod chen po ni/ /zhi ba'i dam tshig 'dod chags spong*/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer rnam bsgoms na/ /rmongs sel khyab 'jug dam tshig go /gzhan du byams pas spang bar dka'/ /rnam pa 'di gsum gsang chen po/ /lha yi bde ba ser snar bcas/ /brtson 'grus phrag dog dam tshig ste/ /g.yo sgyus btud rnams 'dul byed pa/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /padma'i snying po bde ba can/ /ji srid ma rnyed 'bras bu med/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug rtsa 'di yis/ /rdo rje gnyis spangs 'byed par byed/ /shes rab rtogs par byed pa thabs/ /shes rab med la thabs mkhas med/ /rdo rjes padma rgyas byed kyi/ /padmas rdo rje 'byed par byed/ /sprul pa bde chen 'khor los kyang*/ /chos dang longs spyod rnam par 'byed/ /de ltas 'di ni gsang chen te/ /rgyud gzhan du ni 'bad pas sbas/ /de la 'di ni sku gsum rdo rje'i gsang ba'o/ /sems med gnas dang 'khrul bskyed dang*/ /sngon nas rnam par 'khrul ba yi/ /'jig rten 'di la sku gsum gnas/ chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa'o/ /rang byung ngo bo brjod med pa/ /chos kun rang bzhin zhi ba brnyes/ /rkyen ni rnam par bkra ba mkhyen/ /rdo rje can gyis chos sku'o/ /me long gzugs brnyan ltar sems 'di/ /phra zhing lus ni rdul med pa/ /skad kyang sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag pa'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'o/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /sprul pa tha dad sna tshogs 'jug /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa ste/ /gcig gyur 'dren pa bde ba che/ /rtsa yi dra ba lha mo ste/ /de bzhin khams dang nyer bcas pa/

/bud med rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /spangs nas ri mo su zhig len/ /de la 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go /dri mas sems ni mngon bsgom pas/ /rnam shes ye shes dag mi 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog gis bgrod pa'i gnas/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dngos po bden brdzun rnam dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong*/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba ni ye shes dang ldan pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ni dgas par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /traṃ ces bya ba ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /āḥzhes bya ba ni smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ha zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /hrīḥzhes bya ba ni rjes su chags pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /oṃ zhes bya ba ni lus 'jig par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ khaṃ zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /aṃ zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /kṣa zhes bya ba ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /aḥzhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ya zhes bya ba ni rdo rje rlung ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i me ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /wa zhes bya ba ni rdo rje chu ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /taṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i sems te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /iṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i dbang po rnams te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /baṃ zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams su byed pa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /āḥzhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /rnam shes ye shes rnal 'byor te/ /de dag rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor la ni rnal 'byor bsgom/

/rjes kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de la 'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go /spre'u dang glog ltar mi gnas pa/ /rab tu bzung bar dka' ba'i sems/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /gser khams rdo la rnam gnas pa/ /mngon par zhi ba yod ma yin/ /sreg dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /nyi ma bzhin du rnam par gsal/ /lcags bzhin me la rnam bzod na/ /gzhan dag ci phyir mi bzod byed/ /de phyir ye shes rnam shes dag /cha gnyis rnam par rtog mi bya/ /cha gnyis las ni sdig pa 'byung*/ /sdig pas bsod nams zad par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa zhes brjod de/ /bla med bde ba bsod nams so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam gyur pa/ /bsod nams sdig med rnam par thar/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs te/ /dge dang sdig pa rnam par 'byed/ /bu mo'i longs spyod bde ba yis/ /rnam par mi rtog gnyis med 'grub/ /ri bo nyams ni dga' ba dang*/ /nags tshal dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan bzung*/ /dang por 'dus pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje cho ga rab tu bsgrub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /dam tshig chen por byin gyis brlabs/ khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang*/ /de bzhin shin tu brkyang ba dang*/ khab dang gru mo'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /bung ba lta bur i yi sgra/ /nges par blo dang ldan pas bskul/ /sgeg 'chos stabs kyis 'khyud nas ni/ /mgo bo'i skra bzung lkog ma gzir/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi gzhib par bya/ /rdo rje 'khyud pas 'khyud pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'o yis 'o gdab cing*/ /so dang sen mos bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje padmar rab 'jug cing*/ /sīd kyi sgra rnams byed pa dang*/ /nu ma 'tshir dang skyes pa'i tshul/ /sbyor ba thams cad bya bar bya/ /nu ma sor mo ske dang ma mchu dang*/ /rna ba mig dang spyi bo bha gar

yang*/ /'o bya rna ba mchan khung ske dang rtags/ /sen mos btab bya nu ma mchan khung dang*/ /mkhur tshos 'gram dang rkang lag mthil dag tu/ /mnyed par bya zhing 'khyud pa'i stabs brgyad bya/ /sor mo ling ga lce dang lces bskyod nas/ /padma bskul zhing rtsa mchog sad par bya/ /zab ches pa dang shin tu chung ba dang*/ lhod pa dang*/ rtsub pa dang*/ rtag tu 'dzag pa dang*/ drod dang gsher ba dpral ba'i bha ga ni spang ngo*/ /dpangs mtho ba dang*/ 'jam pa dang*/ stong mnyam pa dang*/ kha rgyas shing dam pa dang*/ khrag dang khu bar ldan pa dang*/ spu nyung ba dang*/ dus ma yin par mi 'dzag pa dang*/ ring zhing snying po zlum pa ni skal pa bzang mo'o/ /de yongs su bskul bas ji srid du khong nas sīta kyi sgra 'byung ba de srid du'o/ /haḥzhes bya bas mchog tu dga' ba'i tshe bcings par bya'o/ /yang na hūṃ zhes bya ba snying ga la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /yang na hriṃ ha zhes bya ba mgrin pa la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi bya ba dang*/ mda' bo che'i sbyor ba byas la khu ba bcing bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang cha bzhi pa'i phyed kyi mtshams su lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya ste gal te bha ga'i ze 'bru la gnas pa'i thig le yang rdo rje'i khas btung bar bya'o/ /bskor ba la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ /rlung gi sbyor bas mnyam par bya'o/ /'di la dgang ba dang*/ gzhil ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ /bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ mi mo rnams kyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ lus 'di nyid kyis dngos grub thob pa zhes bya'o/ /de las dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas sgrub pa po la rengs pa dang*/ rngul ba dang*/ ba spu ldang ba dang*/ dbugs 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ kha dog log pa dang*/ mchi ma 'byung ba dang*/ thim pa zhes bya ba snying stobs brgyad 'byung ngo*/ /bu mos ye shes thob pa ni/ snying ni 'gul zhing bskyod pa dang*/ /'dar dang dran pa nyams pa dang*/

/skra grol gcer bu gsher bas khyab/ /mdog dmar rab tu phra ba'i mig /ye shes lnga yi rnam par 'phrul/ /bud med shes rab ye shes te/ /de las ye shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes sbyor ldan pa/ /sku yi rdo rje bsnyen par brjod/ /rlung ni mnyam par gyur pa dang*/ /sīta kyi sgra dang skad 'gyur ba/ /gsung ni nye bar bsgrub pa'o/ /bskyod pa las ni rab zhu ba/ /nor bu bcu drug cha babs te/ /yid kyi bde bas gnyis 'gags pa/ /thugs kyi de nyid bsgrub par brjod/ /gzhu yi gzugs can rab sbyor bas/ /dung dang kunda ltar thig le/ /sdom brtson bde bas bzung bar bya/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes mchog /bsgrub pa chen po'i de nyid de/ /rnam shes ye shes dag par byed/ /'di yis rdo rje bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes chen por rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor mkhas pas bstod/ /bud med sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig rnams kyi mchog gi mchog/ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /sgrib pa dag tu yongs mi 'gyur/ /de skad ces gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnal 'byor dang po'i dam tshig go /utpal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /phyag gnyis rnal 'byor bsgoms byas la/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /dbus su kun nas zlum po ste/ /las kyi snam bu lnga dang ldan/ /utpal dmar po sil mar bkram/ /zla ba nyi ma'i sbyor ba las/ /dam tshig sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /ljang sngon 'od zer dmar po 'khyil/ /mche ba gtsigs pa me stag 'bar/ /mchog sbyin gri gug ḍā ma ru/ /mda' dang utpal sdong bu dang*/ /thod pa khrag can rtse gsum dang*/ /bzhi pa me tog gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod rgyan dang utpal rgyan/ /g.yas brkyang rol pa'i skyil krung can/ /rang rang sngags las lha mo'i tshogs/

/snying ga'i dbus nas spro bar bya/ /oṃ tā re swāhā/ mig la'o oṃ tuttā re swāhā/ rna ba la'o/ /oṃ tu swāhā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ re swāhā/ snying ga la'o/ /oṃ twā re ṇi swāhā/ spyi bo la'o/ /sngags kyi bdag pos byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes dam tshig mnyam par bya/ /dbang gi don ni bsgoms byas la/ /rang lhar sems ni brtan bya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /de nas sgrol mas bka' stsal pa/ oṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ hūṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ bruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ taṃ hūṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadzra satwa/ st+waṃ badzra na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /phyi rol ra ba me rir bcas/ /dur khrod dag kyang bri bar bya/ /dbus su utpal mthing kha dgod/ /shar du zhi ba'i utpal dang*/ /byang du bum pa bri bar bya/ /nub tu lcags kyu 'bar ba ste/ /ral gri lho ru dgod par bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /gsod byed rnams kyi mtshan ma'o/ /grwa bzhir rigs kyi lha mo ste/ /utpal mdzes pa re re bri/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo ru dgod/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa yi/ khro bo rnams kyang grwar dgod do/ /las rnams byed pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /phyi rol dag tu bri bar bya/ /dbus su bdag nyid gnas byas nas/ /rdo rje mtshan ma'i tshogs spros pas/ /sems can khams rnams sbyangs par bya/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /mchog tu gang ba spro bar bya/ /me tog ga bur ma nyams pa/ /bha ga mchog las yang dag blangs/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor los mchod/ /yang gsungs pa/ sgo dgu nges par bkag byas nas/ /rgyas pa lnga yi mchod rten las/

/srog shing rtse mor rang gis sems/ /mda' gzhu'i sbyor bas 'pho bar bya/ mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang*/ /'di yis grol 'gyur the tshom med/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad bya ste/ /mi lpags ras rnying bgo ba'am/ /gcer bu'i brtul zhugs byas nas ni/ /dogs pa'i sems ni kun spangs nas/ /ji lta bur na snang ba 'di/ /'dod spyod bde ba la bsdus nas/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig go /gang las slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /slob dpon gcig tu gyur pa yi/ /sring mo sgrol ma dang mnyam brtag /rdo rje slob dpon de bzhin du/ /rig ma'am bdag gi rig ma yang*/ /slob dpon mchog tu yongs su brjod/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya/ /'on kyang dga' ma dges dbang mo/ /gnyis kyi sgo dgu las byung ba/ /mi rtog snod gcig za ba dang*/ /gtsang sbra'i sems kyis tsum pa dbul/ /lhan cig mal stan longs spyad nas/ /lag gis rdo rje bzung gsor te/ /yo nir sor bya dam 'khyud nas/ /tshig dang yi ges dges bskul bas/ /so dang sen ris 'drud pa dang*/ /'jib dang sgo yis zas 'bul ba/ /gus dang phyag bcas bag brkyang bas/ /'gongs pa 'di la nyes med de/ /slob dpon dges las dngos grub kun/ /bzang mo de yis rtag tu thob/ /yu dza gus pas gzhib pa dang*/ /phyag bya gal te sems lhung gyur/ / 'dab ldan las byung za bar bya/ /yo nis tsa ru dbul ba dang*/ /'khrig thabs 'khrul 'khor nyes med de/ /gang des de nyid mnyes byed pa'o/ /de nas las sna tshogs pa rnams gsungs pa phyogs bzhi dang grwa bzhir utpala'i gzugs bya/ /re re yang tāṃ gsum gyis mtshan pa/ lte ba kun nas zlum po la/ oṃ pra sanna tā re a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ ta lo tsa ni/ sarba artha swa dha ni/ sarba satwa bā shaṃ ka ri/ st+ri bā su ru ṣo bā rā dzā no bā ba shaṃ ku ru tāṃ swāhā/

zhes pa lte bar bkod pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu par padma la yi ge bcu pa'o/ /hrīḥ gnyis kyi nang du ming chud par byas na dbang du byed do/ /yang na rtsibs brgyad pa/ yi ge yang brgyad pa ste dbus su zla ba la tāṃ yig go /'khor lo kha sbyor du byas na nyi ma bdun na nges par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yang na rtsibs drug pa yi ge yang drug pa'o/ /dbus su hriḥ bā shaṃ ku ru hriḥswāhā/ go ro tsa na dang tsandan dmar po dang*/ rgya skyegs dang*/ khrag gi bho dza pa ṭa la bri bar bya ste/ srid pa gsum yang dbang du byed do/ /gur gum la sogs 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ kha sbyor sbyor bas dbang du byed/ /sarba mo hā ni tā re tuttā re sarba duṣtaṃ mo hā ya bha ga wā dī sarba duṣta naṃ bandha bandha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gos kyi mtha' ni mdud byas na/ /chom rkun 'ching bar byed pa'i mchog /utpal la mngon bsngags pas/ /gang la byin pa de dbang 'gyur/ /utpa las mtshan 'khor lo'o/ /chu dbus sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter/ /thod les ming mthar hrī'i bris la/ kham por dbus su bzhag na rengs/ /'dab brgyad padmar ga yig nang*/ /chud cig lte bar ga brgyad bris/ /yung bas rdo leb dag la ste/ kha phub bzhag na shin tu rengs/ /'khor lo de ni dug dang khrag /ske tshe mi rus btags pa'i chus/ /thod par hūṃ phaṭa mtshan par bri/ /'di yis nges par gsod par byed/ /gro gar gur gum gyis bris la/ /oṃ bcas me tog ser pos mchod/ /yang na swāhār chud par bri/ /rgyas dang bsrung ba byed pa'i mchog / rtsibs bcu a yig nang chud pa/ /tsandan chus bri kham phor bcas/ /me tog dri bzang gis mchod na/ /shin tu zhi ba'i las la mchog /bha ga liṅga hrīḥyig gis/ /bskor ba ming dang bskul sngags bcas/ /'di yis bsgrub bya 'gugs par 'gyur/ /padma 'dab ma nyi shu bzhir/ /re kha gsum bskor oṃ hriṃ kliṃ/

/rgyal la bris nas reg byas na/ /bran pho bran mo ltar las byed/ /'khrul 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rje stegs bus brgyan/ /tho ba dbyig tho padma dang*/ /ral gri sgo dang utpa la/ /thod bcas lcags kyu mtshams su'o/ /de dbus 'dab ma bcu pa bri/ /oṃ pra san tā re a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ ta lo tsa ne sarba artha sā dha ni swāhā/ dbang du byed pa'i sngags so/ /de nas bka' stsal pa/ /oṃ sarba mo ha ni tā re tuttā re sarba duṣtan mo ha ya bha ga ba tī sarba duṣtā naṃ bandha bandha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de dbus zla ba tāṃ yig bcas/ /dbus rtsibs drug la ku ru kulle/ /sngags ni hrīḥganyis dbus chud pa'i/ /ming dang bskul bas las kun byed/ /'bum phrag bzlas pas sa g.yo zhing*/ /rgya mtsho bdun bskams dug zhir byed/ /gyo mo'i sbyor bas 'byung bo kun/ /bcings nas klu dang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sbyor ba 'phrog cing char 'bebs dang*/ /mtshon chas mi gnod lus su 'gyur/ /dpyid zla ra bar bu mo mdzes/ /rdul ldan gyi ni ras btags la/ /zla mtshan gyis bsgos de la ni/ /ri mor dam tshig ldan pas bri/ /sgrol ma 'od zer can ma dang*/ /phag mo'i gzugs la mngon mchod na/ /gang gang 'dod pa'i las thams cad/ /thogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i gzungs kyi mthu gsungs pa/ gos mtha' 'am skra la mngon bsngags bcings/ /'brog dgon dag tu 'jigs med 'gyur/ /utpal sbyin sreg brgya rtsa yis/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re a mu kaṃ me ba sha ma na ye swāhā/ bya rog gshog par bsngags nas ni/ /dgra bo'i khyim du sbos na skrod/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shī ghraṃ ga mi ni de ba da ttaṃ uta tsa ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ so so 'cha' dang yungs kar dang*/ /thang phrom a shwa ka'i me tog/ 'dab bcas sbyin sreg byed pa'am/

/yang na mngar gsum bsregs byas na/ / nyin bdun bu mo mchog thob 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re a mu ka bhi dha nāṃ/ /ku mā rī/ ma hya mudpa te na ta syāḥsi ta pra yatstshantu swāhā/ zla mtshan ras la sgrol ma ni/ / utpal zhags pa bsnams pa bri/ /mchod cing lnga stong bzlas nas ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bas spyad/ /oṃ tā rai tuttā re tu ye a mu kī ma ma ba si taṃ/ swa sna karṇe ka thā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ reg phrug tsher ma zla mtshan bcas/ /sreg blugs stong phrag gcig gis ni/ /mi bdag bu mo mchog kyang 'gugs/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re a mu ka bi dha naṃ swasthā nā dā karṣā ya ma mānti ke dzaḥ zla ba gzas bzung 'jig rten dbang*/ /dung dang btags te 'dod mar sbyin/ /yang na sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i sha /arka'i bal la dril byas la/ /ba dmar mar khus mig sman bya/ /rdo rje chos dang nyi ma dang*/ /rta rgyal mchog gi spos bdug nas/ /bltas pas padma gar dbang 'bab/ /ha la ha la'i mjug ma dang*/ /'jam 'bras rtsangs pa'i mjug ma dang*/ /'gron bu ror bcas khu ba 'dzin/ /sdig pa'am sbal pa'i zhag gis sam/ /'o ma rnam gsum sbyar ba dang*/ /a phu mtshal dang sbyar ba ni/ /gu gul bcas pa'i ril bus kyang*/ /rtag tu khu ba rengs par 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re santa ra ṇi hrīḥ de ba datta bā shaṃ ku ru ho/ padma lcags kyu bcas pa yi/ /spu ta liṅgas 'gugs par bya/ /zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams pa yi/ /lha mos 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /oṃ tsa turbha dza ṣaṇmu kha bi kri tā na na karṇa bi shā tsi hūṃ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed kyi bris sku'i mdun du zhag bdun bzlas na/ rna bar sgrog pa grub bo/ /oṃ budha tsu ru mā tsu ru ke swāhā/ mchod rten gyi drung du gtsang sbra dang bcas pas bzlas na/ bdag nyid gang du skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ tshe zad pa dang*/ ring du 'tsho ba yang shes par 'gyur ro/

/sbrul gyis sbal pa'i bzung ba na/ /de dag dud med thal bar bya/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba mchan khung du/ /thig le byas na 'gugs par 'gyur/ /mi tshil mi yi thod par bzhag /narma'i bal gyis sdong bur bya/ /gzugs 'tshong thod pa dag las ni/ /snag tsha blangs te bu mo la/ /thig le byas na 'gugs par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra tīkṣa ya hūṃ swāhā/ 'o ma la lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas bkrus na mig gi rab rib sel bar 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rting pa'i sha dang*/ byi la nag mo'i mchin pa'i bdug pas gnas dang rdzas kyi 'byung po skrod par 'gyur ro/ /nirgu ṭa dang munṭi dang bhadga ra nag po dang*/ /bhadga dang nimba tig ta rnams grib ma la bskams pa dang*/ be la wa dang*/ dzadgi ha ri ta ki rnams bu ram la sbyar nas dang po lnga dang phyi nas chu tshod gcig nas lhag ma yang sor mo gsum gyi tshad du zos na zla ba drug nas rgan po yang gzhon nur byed pa la the tshom med do/ /na mo bi ga ta rā ga me tri ya sidha lo tsa ne swāhā/ zhes pas kyang rab rib sel bar byed do/ /zlum po mtshams su rdo rjes brgyan/ /hūṃ bzhis rdo rje legs par mtshan/ /oṃ pa da kra ma sī/ pa ra kra ma sī/ u da ya ma sī/ nirma ma sī/ arka ma sī/ marga ma sī/ urma mā sī/ ba na ma sī/ gulma ma sī/ tsi ba ra ma sī/ mahā tsi ba ra ma sī/ antaddha na ma sī swāhā/ lte ba la bri ste oṃ ni thams cad du'o/ /dbus su rdo rje'i g.yas dang g.yon du/ oṃ brta lī oṃ ba rā li/ oṃ ba rā ha mu khī zhes bri'o/ /mtshams su yang*/ oṃ mā ri tsye zhes bri'o/ /dbus su oṃ bā rā lī/ oṃ ba tā lī/ oṃ pa rā ha mu khī sarba duṣtaṃ pra duṣtaṃ kā ye bāktsitte mu khaṃ dzambha ya/ staṃ bha ya zhes so/ /dbus su maṃ yig go /de'i nang du de ba datta rakṣa rakṣa'o/ /'di ni gro ga la gur gum gyis bris na thams cad du bsrung ba ste/ 'od zer can ma'i 'khor lo'o/

/yang gsungs pa/ dbus su lha mo gser mtshungs pa/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba can/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rnal 'byor ma ni bcu dang bcas/ /grwa bzhir 'byung ba bzhi yang dgod/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di sku yi ni/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bla med pa'o/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /bha ga'i dbus su zla ba bsgom/ /dmar mo bcu gnyis lo yi tshul/ /phyag rgya lnga dang thod pas brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyangs rol par mdzad/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa'o/ /spyi bor utpal phreng ba bcings/ /g.yas pa nag po ser po dang*/ /sna tshogs 'bar bas rnam par 'phro/ /dkar po ljang khu sngon po ni/ /g.yon gyi zhal la rim pas so/ /steng zhal dud kha bong bu'i gzugs/ / ral gri utpal mda' bo che/ /rdo rje kyo ba dbyug pa dang*/ /zangs gri mi 'jigs phyag rgya'o/ /thod pa sdigs mdzub de nas gzhan/ /gzhu dang kha ṭwāṃ zhags pa dang*/ / mgo bo nor bu bum par bcas/ /mche gtsigs 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma/ /he ru ka yi sgrol ma'o/ /tāṃ las ljang khu zhal gcig ma/ /mchog sbyin utpal bsnams pa yis/ /'dod pa thams cad sbyin par byed/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa ste/ /yi ge brgyad bzlas nges 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje gdong ldan phyag gnyis dmar/ /he ru ka dpal yum gyur pa'am/ /'khor lo bde mchog rim pa las/ /yang na he ru ka sbyor bas/ /gang la dga' ba de 'grub 'gyur/ /thod pa rdo rje khrag 'thung dang*/ /gri gug phag mos bsnams pa'o/ /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par mnan/ /thal ba 'tsho byed kha ṭwāṃ bcas/ /bha ga liṅga zlog par bya/ rdo rjes bsnun nas khrag 'thungs pas/ /skad cig gcig gis gsod par byed/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /bu mo thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ khu ba khrag dang chang dang ni/ /gong bu la sogs dgug par bya/

/oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūṃ/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ/ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi dya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ gi ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje sumbha rab tu gnag /rdo rje 'bar ba dung dmar dang*/ /gtun shing sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mda' gzhu dbyug tho 'dzin pa'i mchog /rdo rje zhags pa sdigs 'dzub can/ /spyan gsum g.yon brkyang stabs bsgom bya/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa yi/ /lha yi rgyal po 'di dag go /lha mo nag mo rnal 'byor bsgom/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa'i lag /lha min 'joms pa dgra bo yi/ /mgo gcod tri shū la 'chang ma/ /bya rgod lce spyang tsī la spro/ /rgyu ma mi mgo'i me tog can/ /ma mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /ro la zhon pa rnam par bsgom/ /yang na stag mo la gnas pa/ /drag shul spyod pas bsgom par bya/ khu ba rdo rjer byas pa las/ /rang gi sems ni rdo rjer 'gyur/ /rnam rtog med cing spros dang bral/ /mkha' ltar rang bzhin gos pa med/ /rang rig bde ba chen po ste/ /dbang bskur mchog ni 'di dag go /me long gzugs brnyan 'dra sems kyis/ /thig le rdo rjer byed par 'gyur/ /srog dang thur sel sgo dbye bas/ /btsan thabs sbyor bas dbugs bkag na/ khu ba mi 'gyur 'thob pa ste/ /thig le nor bur bkag ste bsgom/ /lha mo'i gzugs brnyan bsgyur bar bya/ /sgrol ma sgrol ma can grub 'gyur/ /yang na thogs med gzugs kyis te/ /skyes pa bud med nges 'grub 'gyur/ /las rab 'byams kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /dam tshig mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'byams dang*/ /bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos mngon par bstod byas nas/ /lag na rdo rje 'chang la rgyud 'di gtad/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las ji snyed pa rtsa ba'i rtog pa rdzogs so/

/rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa grub chen buddha nā tha'i zhabs las mnos nas/ slar rgya gar gyi mkhan po nirbā ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas dang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyis byung gi paṇḍi ta mi'i nyi ma'i dka' 'grel dang bstun te g.yar khral du bsgyur ba'o/ /yang slad kyis bhang ga lar 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍi ta purṇa badzra'i drung du/ /slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel chen po dang bstun nas cung zad bcos shing*/ thams cad du grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi zhal lung gi reg zig so so rnams dang*/ khyad par gu ru lho phyogs pa chen po'i man ngag dang bstun nas legs par bcos te dag par bgyis pa'o// //zhus dag/ bkra shis//
